review_scope: Primary read the complete first-pass report and independently read the complete generator, browser JavaScript and grader. All other required files were read completely by the first-pass reviewer; this is not an independent double annotation of every source file.
decision: Keep all four baseline labels, with no supported configuration exception. Forward-versus-jump legality depends on actual roof heights. Program and subroutine choices affect later heading, position and lamp visits. The initial map and editor expose the information needed to plan; execution is computed before automatic playback, after which a static status enables certification. Untimed drag-and-drop placement is not a temporal requirement.
uncertainties: Source audit, not visual calibration or screenshot-only gameplay evidence.
